en: A colorized historic postcard view of a large sanatorium complex with white multi‑story buildings and red roofs nestled in a forested, hilly landscape. A clock tower rises among the roofs, and there are trees and rocks in the foreground with distant hills in the background. At the top in red Gothic-style script is the printed title "Heilstätte Hohwald b. Neustadt i. Sa." Handwritten pencil and ink annotations appear near the top.
